thread:
maya: Heads-up — onboarding Xeno's LoRA merge. Quick eval on int4 looks off for code-gen prompts, and we have a tokenizer mismatch on emoji sequences. 
liam: logs? sample outputs?
maya: pasted a couple: 
```
input: "Write a JS function to parse iso dates 📅"
host (fp16): "function parseIsoDate(str) { return new Date(str); }"
int4: "function parseIsoDate(str) { // wrong parsing, uses substring indexes, returns NaN }"
```
liam: yikes. tokenization note? which tokenizer?
maya: Xeno trained on a whitespace-variant tokenizer (their finetune used a patched BPE that treats emoji clusters as single tokens). Our infra used standard tokenizer so emojis get split and KV align breaks.
san: sounds like a token-id shift; could explain prompt framing change + cache mismatch. Did we try forcing their tokenizer vocab during merge?
maya: not yet — initial bake used only merged weights + our default vocab. I ran a small evalpack (50 prompts) with metrics: exact-match dropped 12%, logprob delta ~-0.9 on avg, and code-syntax error rate x4.
anya: also check quantization calibration. If embedding layer scales differ, int4 can amplify tokenization errors. Can you drop the quant and run int8 or fp16 as baseline?
maya: starting fp16 now, queued job id: eval-1779991. Meanwhile can we try remapping emoji sequences to single placeholder token as a fast probe? e.g., replace /\p{Emoji}+/ -> <EMOJI> in prompts.
liam: good quick probe. If that fixes generation, it's tokenizer alignment for sure. If not, then quant is suspect.
ops-bot: eval-1779991 started on ded-cluster-7 (g4dn-sim), ETA ~12m.
maya: result: fp16 baseline recovered ~98% of expected behavior. Remap probe recovered ~85%. So both tokenizer mismatch and int4 quantization contribute.
san: plan: 1) produce a merge that preserves Xeno tokenizer (vocab + merges) in our model artifact, 2) run per-layer quant calibration with their data for int4, 3) ship a small evalpack (200 prompts) with targeted emoji/code prompts.
liam: agree. I'll add steps to the onboarding checklist and note we need an adapter for tokenizer in serving pipeline.
anya: also add a rollback rule in routing — if token-prob drift > 0.6 vs baseline on canary, auto-fallback to fp16.
maya: assigning tasks: liam (tokenizer artifact + serving adapter), sam (quant calibration script + evalpack), anya (routing/fallback), me (customer comms + run big eval). ETA EOD tomorrow?
sam: on it, I'll reuse the cal script from pavo-int4 run and adapt for their vocab.
liam: I'll prototype tokenizer shim and push a canary config.
ops-bot: evalpack-200 queued as job eval-1779992 on ded-cluster-9, ETA ~45m.
maya: thanks — will sync results in this thread. :thumbsup:
